surfaces.name: Kilo CLI and TUI (kilo, kilo serve, kilo run)
Kilo Code VS Code extension (incl. Agent Manager)
Kilo Code JetBrains plugin (v7 early access)
Kilo hosted platform (Cloud Agents, web app, mobile apps, Gateway, Gas Town)

claims.answer: Clients: VS Code extension (macOS, Linux, Windows; VS Code 1.105.1+), JetBrains plugin (v7 early access), CLI/TUI binaries for macOS, Linux and Windows, Kilo Desktop installer (macOS Apple Silicon, Windows x64/ARM64, Linux x64/ARM64), the Cloud Agent web app at app.kilo.ai, and iOS and Android apps that manage Cloud Agent and remote CLI/extension sessions. Slack, GitHub and Linear entry points exist via Kilo Connect.

claims.answer: Kilo embeds its own harness (CLI is a fork of OpenCode) with built-in Code, Plan, Ask and Debug agents plus custom agents, and exposes an ACP server; it does not launch other agent CLIs. Model providers are extensive (500+ models via Kilo Gateway, dozens of direct providers, local servers, custom OpenAI-compatible endpoints).

evidence.title: Remote session relay
evidence.finding: Local CLI/extension sessions relay over a websocket to Kilo cloud so web and mobile clients can view, prompt and run commands; requires Kilo Gateway sign-in.

evidence.title: Memory runtime
evidence.finding: Memory save and recall tools backed by per-project Markdown files.

evidence.title: Codebase indexing
evidence.finding: Local semantic indexing with LanceDB and a semantic_search tool; indexing consent flow in the extension.

evidence.title: MCP in the CLI
evidence.finding: MCP client with local and remote servers; kilo mcp command; OAuth for remote servers.

evidence.title: Skills docs
evidence.finding: Agent Skills in global and project locations plus remote URLs; marketplace installs.

evidence.title: Kilo-Org/cloud license
evidence.finding: Open Core Ventures Source Available License 1.0: free to modify and test; production use requires a commercial agreement from the copyright holder.

evidence.title: Cloud Agent worker
evidence.finding: Cloudflare Worker with Session and Sandbox Durable Objects running Kilo tasks in isolated sandboxes with GitHub integration; child session callbacks.

evidence.title: Kilo mobile app source
evidence.finding: Mobile app tabs Home, Agents, Chat, Profile with PR review; Quick Chat to Kilo, custom backends or on-device models.

evidence.title: Wakeup scheduler behavior
evidence.finding: A missed cron window is skipped rather than replayed and the claim arms the next window; deterministic per-task jitter (up to 15s) is clamped so it never passes expiry; file-lock contention retries with backoff; no failed-run retry policy was found.

evidence.title: Search of the public cloud repository for Gas Town
evidence.finding: Only platform labels, billing SKUs, feature detection and secret-pattern files mention Gas Town; no town, bead, convoy or mayor implementation exists in the public cloud or kilocode repositories, so the feature is a hosted closed component described only by docs.

evidence.title: Cloud Agent sandbox providers
evidence.locator: services/cloud-agent-next/src/sandbox-control/vercel-provider.ts lines 37 and 88; src/metered-billing-lifecycle.ts lines 114 and 505; src/shared/control-plane-protocol.ts line 319
evidence.finding: Cloud Agent sandboxes run through Vercel sandbox and Cloudflare container providers; a region string is part of the sandbox session; metered billing ends with an activity_expired reason when activity lapses; idle and maximum lifetimes are not read.

evidence.title: Kilo v7.8.28 release
evidence.finding: CLI changes: hosted workspace profile defaults in the Session Host API; plugin tool schema handling; GitHub marks the release as pre-release.

evidence.title: GitHub repository metadata
evidence.finding: 28,022 stars on 2026-11-16; MIT per GitHub detection; not archived; pushed 2026-11-16.

evidence.title: Kilo pricing
evidence.locator: Platform plans; AI inference options; Kilo Pass; Cloud compute
evidence.finding: Free and open source $0 (usage billed separately); Teams $15/user/month; Enterprise custom; Kilo Gateway pay-as-you-go at provider rates with a 5% credit purchase fee; Kilo Pass $19/$49/$199 per month with bonus credits; Code Review $0.33/hour; Cloud Agent $0.60 to $1.20/hour.
